## listRunsForContact

List Flow Runs For Contact. `GET /contacts/{contact_id}/flow-runs`

List flow runs for a specific contact.

Used by the contact-detail "Flows" tab. When status is omitted the response defaults to active runs (running + waiting) — the rows a user expects to see. Pass an explicit status to inspect history.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->listRunsForContact(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`, `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$status` | `FlowRunStatus\|string\|null` | no | Filter by run status. Defaults to active runs (running + waiting) when omitted. |
| `$flowId` | `?string` | no | Filter to a specific flow |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<FlowRun>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/list_flow_runs_for_contact_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__flow_runs_get)

## reorder

Reorder Flows. `PATCH /flows/reorder`

Re-order flow trigger priorities for the current tenant.

Accepts EITHER an ordered flow_ids list (server assigns priority = position, 0-based, so the first id wins) OR an explicit items: [{flow_id, priority}] list. Exactly one shape must be supplied. Lower priority = higher precedence (evaluated first when multiple flows match the same inbound event).

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->reorder();
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Ordered flow ids; server assigns priority = position (0-based). |
| `$items` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Explicit per-flow priority assignments. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ReorderFlows`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/reorder_flows_api_v1_flows_reorder_patch)

## stopRunByRunId

Stop Flow Run By Run Id. `POST /flows/runs/{run_id}/stop`

Operator-initiated cancel of a flow run, by run_id alone.

Convenience companion to POST /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/stop for callers (notably the Conversations UI) that have the run id from the conversation's active_flow_run.run_id but no flow_id. Marks the run canceled, deletes pending waits and cancels any flows it started and is waiting on (Start Flow node). Idempotent — already-terminal runs return their current row unchanged.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->stopRunByRunId(runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FlowRun`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/stop_flow_run_by_run_id_api_v1_flows_runs__run_id__stop_post)

## validate

Validate Flow. `POST /flows/validate`

Check a flow definition without saving it.

Runs exactly the checks of POST /flows (or, with flow_id, of PATCH /flows/{flow_id}) and writes nothing. A definition that would be rejected returns the same 422 as a save: detail = {code: "flow_definition_invalid", message, errors: [{path, message}]} with path naming the node by its ID (reason: channel_chain_required for an unusable channel chain, reason: live_flow_invalid when flow_id is a live flow and the publish checks fail).

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->validate(definition: []);
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`, `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$definition` | `array<string, mixed>` | yes | The flow definition to check (trigger + nodes[] + edges[] + entry_node_id). Hard-capped at 256 KB JSON-encoded. |
| `$defaultChannelChain` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Flow-level channel chain, same shape as on POST /flows. Omitted: on a new flow the server default (all non-email channels) is assumed, exactly as create would seed it; with flow_id the flow's stored chain is used. |
| `$flowId` | `?string` | no | Validate as an edit of this existing flow (PATCH checks). When the flow is live (published or paused) the full publish checks run too and a failure carries reason: live_flow_invalid, exactly like a live PATCH. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FlowValidate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/validate_flow_api_v1_flows_validate_post)

## getVariables

Get Flow Variables. `GET /flows/variables`

Return the typed variable catalog used by the Flow Builder's Branch node "match contact field / tag / list / custom field" picker.

custom_fields is filled only when the caller also holds custom_fields:read (the scope of GET /custom-fields; literal, contacts:read does not imply it); without it the section is an empty list. tags is filled only with contacts:read or conversations:read (the scopes of GET /tags); without either it is an empty list. Every other section is unchanged.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->getVariables();
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `?string` | no | Optional flow ID. When provided, the response also includes the flow's own flow.vars.<output_var> variables walked from its collect_input / kb_query / create_tracked_link nodes. |

Returns `FlowVariables`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/get_flow_variables_api_v1_flows_variables_get)

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->update(flowId: 'flow_id');
```

| `$exclusive` | `?bool` | no | When True, a running run of this entry flow blocks all OTHER entry flows from starting on the same conversation. Omit on PATCH to preserve the current value. |
| `$exitOnUnsubscribe` | `?string` | no | When an active run of this flow ends because the contact unsubscribed (run cancel reason contact_unsubscribed). Only unsubscribes after the run started count. trigger_list (default): when the contact leaves the list whose subscription started the run; inert for every other trigger. any: on an unsubscribe from any list or a channel-wide opt-out. selected: on an unsubscribe from one of exit_on_unsubscribe_list_ids. off: never. Omit on PATCH to preserve the current value. |
| `$exitOnUnsubscribeListIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | List ids used when exit_on_unsubscribe is selected (1 to 50 lists of this workspace). Kept as stored for the other modes. Omit on PATCH to preserve the current value. |
| `$version` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$revisionSource` | `?string` | no | Version history attribution (optional): canvas \| json \| ai_assistant. Defaults to canvas for a signed-in user. API keys and OAuth apps are always recorded as api. |
| `$revisionSummary` | `?string` | no | Optional note stored on the version history entry (max 500 characters, plain text). |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AppSchemasFlowSchemaFlow`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/update_flow_api_v1_flows__flow_id__patch)

## deletePermanently

Delete Flow Permanently. `DELETE /flows/{flow_id}/permanent`

Permanently delete a flow — irreversible, destroys run history.

Distinct from DELETE /flows/{id}, which soft-archives (reversible via POST /flows/{id}/unarchive). This endpoint removes the flows row AND every child row: flow_runs, flow_run_steps, flow_run_waits. No FK cascades exist on the flow tables, so the service deletes children explicitly inside one transaction. Keyword-bot wiring that pointed at the flow is detached (set to NULL) rather than deleted. Conversation messages and tracked_links produced by the flow are KEPT — they are real history and their flow attribution readers are already best-effort.

```php
$sendseven->flows()->deletePermanently(flowId: 'flow_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |

## startRun

Start Flow Run. `POST /flows/{flow_id}/runs`

Start a flow run for a contact.

Honors idempotency from EITHER the request body field idempotency_key OR the HTTP header Idempotency-Key (body wins on conflict). The engine's start_run returns the existing run on collision with HTTP 200; new runs return HTTP 201.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->startRun(flowId: 'flow_id', contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | Contact UUID on the tenant's shard |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Optional caller-supplied idempotency key for at-most-once start semantics. If a run with the same (tenant_id, idempotency_key) already exists, the existing run is returned with HTTP 200 instead of creating a new one. If omitted, the engine derives a key from the request payload (e.g. manual:<flow_id>:<contact_id>:<request_id>). |
| `$context` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Extra variables to seed flow_runs.context.vars. Hard-capped at 16 KB JSON-encoded. |
| `$contactMethodOverrides` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Optional map of ChannelType (string value, e.g. email, sms, whatsapp, telegram, messenger, instagram, browser_push) → contact_method.id. When the flow sends on the matching channel, this specific contact_method's value is used as the destination instead of the contact's primary method. Per-channel keys are independent; omitted channels fall back to the default (primary) resolution. Each referenced contact_method must belong to the same tenant, the same contact, and have a method_type that matches the channel key. |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Optional channel the run is started on (an active channel of this workspace). It becomes the run's originating/current channel: Send steps prefer it (when the flow prefers the originating channel) and Tag & Update entries scoped to the "current channel" use it. |
| `$contactMethodId` | `?string` | no | Optional contact method (of this contact) the run is started with. With channel_id it must be able to address that channel, and it is also applied as the contact_method_overrides pin for that channel type unless one was given explicitly. |
| `$conversationId` | `?string` | no | Optional conversation (of this contact) the run is started from, e.g. "Run flow" in the inbox. Marks the run's origin only, so the conversation shows it as running; it does not bind the run to the conversation. |
| `$idempotencyKeyIdempotency` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FlowRun`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/start_flow_run_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs_post)

## listRunMessages

List Flow Run Messages. `GET /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/messages`

Returns the chronological transcript of outbound (Send-node) and inbound (Wait-for-reply matched) messages stamped with this flow_run_id. Reuses the existing idx_msg_flow_run_id / idx_messages_tenant_flow_run index.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->listRunMessages(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<FlowRunMessage>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/list_flow_run_messages_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs__run_id__messages_get)

## getRunReplay

Get Run Replay. `GET /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/replay`

Per-contact replay timeline for a single flow run.

Merges flow_run_steps (engine audit trail) with messages (outbound + inbound tagged with this flow_run_id) into a single time-ordered event stream. Returns the contact header + the run summary + the full event list.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->getRunReplay(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `Replay`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/get_run_replay_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs__run_id__replay_get)

## listRunSteps

List Flow Run Steps. `GET /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/steps`

List the audit-trail rows for a single flow run, oldest first.

Each row is enriched from the CURRENT flows.definition: * node_label — editor-visible label (display_name → snapshot label/name → derived). * node_config_snapshot — a curated subset of the node's current config (e.g. for collect_input: validation, max_attempts, on_timeout_node_id, prompt). NOT a point-in-time snapshot of what the engine executed — callers that need that fidelity should rely on input_snapshot. * branch_taken — best-effort from output_snapshot.chosen_branch.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->listRunSteps(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<FlowRunStep>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/list_flow_run_steps_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs__run_id__steps_get)

## stopRun

Stop Flow Run. `POST /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/stop`

Operator-initiated cancel of a flow run.

Marks the run canceled, deletes pending waits and cancels any flows it started and is waiting on (Start Flow node). Idempotent — already-terminal runs return their current row unchanged.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->stopRun(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FlowRun`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/stop_flow_run_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs__run_id__stop_post)

## startTestRun

Start Test Run. `POST /flows/{flow_id}/test-run`

Start a test run of a flow (draft or published) for the calling user.

The run uses the workspace's live chat channel and a shared test contact, so nothing reaches real customers: Send steps on other channels, API calls, tag changes and similar side effects are simulated and show simulated: true in the trace. Conversational Agent steps run for real in the test conversation. Starting a new test run ends the caller's previous one for this flow.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->startTestRun(flowId: 'flow_id', triggerType: 'trigger_type');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$triggerType` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$simulateChannelId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$simulateLanguage` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$triggerText` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `StartTestRun`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/start_test_run_api_v1_flows__flow_id__test_run_post)

## endTestRun

End Test Run. `DELETE /flows/{flow_id}/test-run/{run_id}`

```php
$sendseven->flows()->endTestRun(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

## sendTestInbound

Send Test Inbound. `POST /flows/{flow_id}/test-run/{run_id}/inbound`

Simulate an inbound message for a flow test run.

Body {text?, attachment_ids?}: at least one is required (422 test_inbound_empty). attachment_ids (max 5) must be tenant attachments from POST /attachments/upload; a foreign or unknown id returns 422 test_inbound_attachment_invalid and nothing is sent. An unknown / non-test run stays 404.

```php
$sendseven->flows()->sendTestInbound(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$text` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$attachmentIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/send_test_inbound_api_v1_flows__flow_id__test_run__run_id__inbound_post)

## getValidation

Get Flow Validation. `GET /flows/{flow_id}/validation`

Return the publish-time validation snapshot for a flow.

Same shape as FlowResponse.validation — exposed as a dedicated endpoint so the Flows editor can poll cheap validation passes after local edits without re-fetching the whole flow row. The Flows editor uses this to gate the "Activate" button and surface inline {path, message} warnings on the offending nodes / trigger.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->getValidation(flowId: 'flow_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `FlowValidationStatus`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/get_flow_validation_api_v1_flows__flow_id__validation_get)
